repos.summary_zh: vue-element-admin 是一个基于 Vue 2.6+ 和 Element UI 2.7+ 的现代化企业级后台管理系统解决方案，提供国际化支持、权限管理、数据可视化等完整功能，支持快速搭建复杂单页应用，适用于中大型管理后台开发。
repos.summary_en: vue-element-admin is a production-ready front-end solution for admin interfaces built on Vue 2.6+ and Element UI 2.7+. It features i18n support, role-based permissions, dashboard widgets, and enterprise-grade templates to accelerate development of complex single-page applications.

repos.description: A CSS-first, native, zero-build layout and styling framework for web designers.
repos.summary_zh: Yeti 是 Foundation 推出的下一代纯 CSS 布局与样式框架，零构建依赖，基于 CSS Container Queries、Cascade Layers、原生 Nesting 等现代特性驱动。提供意图导向的命名布局、单一 Token 刻度系统与开箱即用的可访问组件，机器可读清单配合 MCP 服务器，面向 2025 基线浏览器优化。
repos.summary_en: Yeti is Foundation's next-gen CSS-first layout and styling framework with zero build requirements, leveraging native CSS features like Container Queries, Cascade Layers, and Nesting. It offers intent-based named layouts, a single token scale system, accessible-by-default components, and a machine-readable manifest with MCP server support, targeting Baseline 2025 browsers.

repos.description: 全面ESM+Vue3+Vite+Element-Plus+TypeScript编写的一款后台管理系统（兼容移动端）
repos.summary_zh: vue-pure-admin 是一款基于 ESM 规范的现代化中后台管理系统模板，采用 Vue3+Vite+Element-Plus+TypeScript 技术栈构建，支持移动端适配。提供完整的前端架构与组件库，包含国际化精简版本，打包体积优化至350KB以下，配套详细文档与视频教程，支持 Docker 部署与 Gitpod 在线开发。
repos.summary_en: vue-pure-admin is a modern admin template built with ESM standard, using Vue3+Vite+Element-Plus+TypeScript stack. It supports mobile adaptation, offers complete frontend architecture and component library, includes i18n thin version with optimized bundle size under 350KB, and provides comprehensive documentation, video tutorials, Docker support, and Gitpod integration.

repos.description: 文言文編程語言 A programming language for the ancient Chinese.
repos.summary_zh: 文言（wenyan-lang）是一款基于文言文语法的编程语言，将古典中文与现代编程结合，支持自然语言编程风格。它可将文言文代码编译为 JavaScript，实现如 Hello World、埃拉托斯特尼筛法、快速排序等算法，兼具文化传承与实用功能，适合教学、趣味编程及跨时代语言实验。
repos.summary_en: Wenyan-lang is a programming language based on Classical Chinese grammar, blending ancient Chinese literature with modern programming. It compiles to JavaScript and supports natural language programming, enabling implementations of algorithms like Hello World, Sieve of Eratosthenes, and Quicksort, making it ideal for educational, cultural, and experimental use cases.

repos.description: Grumpy is a Python to Go source code transcompiler and runtime.
repos.summary_zh: Grumpy 是一个将 Python 源码编译为 Go 源码并生成原生代码的转编译器，旨在作为 CPython 2.7 的近乎即插即用的替代品。其核心优势在于无虚拟机（VM），直接生成高效 Go 代码，通过 Grumpy 运行时库提供类似 Python C API 的功能，适用于高性能 Python 应用部署。
repos.summary_en: Grumpy is a Python-to-Go transcompiler and runtime designed as a near drop-in replacement for CPython 2.7. It compiles Python source to Go code, which is then compiled to native machine code—eliminating the need for a VM. This enables high-performance execution via a Go-based runtime library, offering a viable alternative for deploying Python applications with native speed.

repos.description: Collaborative multi-agent AI coding workspace: aggregate sessions from Claude Code, Codex, OpenCode, Pi, Grok Build, etc. Desktop app, self-hosted server, or Docker.
repos.summary_zh: Codeg是一款协作式多智能体AI编码工作空间，统一整合Claude Code、Codex、Grok等15+主流AI编程代理。提供桌面应用、自托管服务及Docker部署方案，支持跨平台使用。核心特性包括会话跨代理迁移、任务委托协作、统一对话界面，大幅降低多代理协作门槛。
repos.summary_en: Codeg is a collaborative multi-agent AI coding workspace unifying 15+ AI agents like Claude Code, Codex, and Grok. Supports desktop, self-hosted, and Docker deployments across all platforms. Key features include session migration between agents, collaborative task delegation via @mentions, and a unified conversation interface.

repos.description: 做最好的接口管理平台
repos.summary_zh: DOClever 是一款专为中小型团队打造的商业化开源接口管理平台，完全免费并支持内网部署。它提供接口全生命周期管理、可视化调试、Mock 服务、自动化测试、团队协作及多格式导入导出等功能，支持 HTTP/HTTPS 协议及多种参数类型，具备版本控制与快照能力，助力高效开发协作。
repos.summary_en: DOClever is a commercial open-source API management platform, fully free and supportable for on-premise deployment. It offers comprehensive API lifecycle management, visual debugging, Mock services, automated testing, team collaboration, and import/export in multiple formats. Supporting HTTP/HTTPS protocols and various parameter types, it features version control, snapshots, and seamless integration with Postman, Swagger, and RAP.

repos.description: A powerful no-code automation tool. Build workflows via drag-and-drop modules for web scraping, form filling and automated testing. | 一款功能强大的自动化工具，通过拖拽模块的方式快速构建自动化工作流，无需编写任何代码即可实现网页数据采集、表单填写、自动化测试等任务。【QQ交流群：115069513】
repos.summary_zh: Web RPA 是一款强大的可视化网页自动化工具，支持零代码拖拽构建自动化工作流，涵盖网页数据采集、表单填写、自动化测试等场景。基于 FastAPI + React 架构，集成 273 个功能模块，涵盖浏览器自动化、数据处理、数据库操作、媒体处理、PDF 转换、文档转换等全栈能力，提供智能搜索、Mermaid 流程图、变量自动补全等高效开发特性，支持非商业免费使用。
repos.summary_en: Web RPA is a powerful visual automation tool enabling zero-code workflow creation via drag-and-drop. It supports web scraping, form filling, and testing with 273 built-in modules across browser automation, data processing, database operations, media handling, PDF conversion, and document transformation. Built on FastAPI + React, it offers smart search, Mermaid flowcharts, variable autocompletion, and full non-commercial free usage.

repos.description: A smart and beautiful markdown editor.
repos.summary_zh: Markcook 是一款基于 Vue 2.0 和 Vuex 2.0 开发的智能美观 Markdown 编辑器，采用 Google Material Design 风格。支持多文件切换、拖拽加载、自动保存至本地存储、一键插入 Markdown 语法及导出为 Markdown 或 HTML 文件，提供流畅的动画交互与护眼配色，兼具在线便捷性与本地应用体验。
repos.summary_en: Markcook is a smart and beautiful markdown editor built with VueJS 2.0 and Vuex 2.0, featuring Google Material Design. It supports multi-file editing, drag-and-drop loading, auto-save to local storage, toolbar-based markdown insertion, and export to .md or .html. With smooth animations, low-contrast colors, and componentized architecture, it offers a seamless online experience akin to desktop apps.

repos.description: A skill for coding agents that build, review, and refactor Web UI that should be easier for humans, screen readers, browser automation, Playwright tests, and AI agents to understand and operate.
repos.summary_zh: 为AI编码代理提供的Web UI设计技能，指导构建、审查与重构前端界面，使其对人类、屏幕阅读器、浏览器自动化、Playwright测试及AI代理更友好。核心聚焦语义HTML、清晰状态、稳定定位器与可复现URL模式，附带分级审查报告，助力提升前端可访问性与自动化兼容性。
repos.summary_en: A skill for coding agents to build, review, and refactor Web UI that is easier for humans, screen readers, browser automation, Playwright tests, and AI agents to understand and operate. It focuses on semantic HTML, clear state, stable locators, and reproducible URL patterns, providing severity-graded review reports to enhance accessibility and automation compatibility.
